subject: Vendor onboarding: PO routing, invoice window & early payment incentive
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@solacepay.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.finance@solacepay.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding question — PO process & payment terms

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick intro on the onboarding call this morning. Two quick asks from our side as we start the vendor intake paperwork:

1) PO routing — what exact vendor name and PO/email header should our billing team expect so invoices are auto-matched?
2) Payment windows — we typically see Net30 but your platform mentioned Net45/60 options. Are you able to enroll vendors in an early-payment program (shorter pay window for a small discount)? If so, what are the enrollment steps and expected settlement timing?

I've attached our completed onboarding form and W-9 for faster review. Also attaching a sample invoice so you can confirm the header.

Attachments: SolacePay_Onboarding_Form.pdf, SolacePay_W9.pdf, Sample_PO.pdf

Best,
Olivia Park
Head of Partnerships
SolacePay

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@solacepay.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — PO process & payment terms

Hi Olivia — thanks for sending the docs, and welcome. Quick answers below, and David from Finance is cc'd to confirm the payment-side details and next steps.

PO routing: Please submit invoices to ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com and include the PO number in the subject line (PO-XXXX). Our AP portal will auto-match on vendor name + PO. The vendor name in our system should be exactly "SolacePay, Inc." (that matches your W-9).

Payment terms & early-pay program: We support Net30 / Net45 / Net60 depending on contract and PO type. Separately, we run a FastPay enrollment for vendors who want accelerated settlement:
- Standard FastPay offer: 1.0% discount if invoice is paid within 14 days of receipt (applies to Net45 invoices enrolled in FastPay).
- Alternative: For Net30 invoices we can offer 0.5% discount for 10-day settlement (rare but available for high-volume partners).

To enroll: complete the onboarding form (looks like you did), sign the FastPay addendum (DocuSign link below), and confirm bank details for ACH. Once Finance confirms we will enable FastPay at the account level — then eligible invoices will route through the accelerated pay queue.

Next steps I can take today: 1) Confirm intake form is complete, 2) route to Finance for enrollment, 3) share an example PO header and sample remittance to test. David, can you confirm turnaround for enabling FastPay once onboarding and bank verification are done?

Links: FastPay addendum: https://app.docusign.com/ind/signer?d=abcdef123456
Onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cOnboardingChecklist

Thanks — Vanessa
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Park <olivia@solacepay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — PO process & payment terms

Hi Olivia, Vanessa —

Thanks for the context. We reviewed the form and W-9; everything looks in order. A few implementation notes from AP/Finance:

1) Bank verification: Once SolacePay completes the FastPay addendum (DocuSign) we'll kick off ACH verification. That typically takes 2 business days for micro-deposits.
2) Enrollment timing: After bank verification we can turn on FastPay for your account; you should see the first eligible invoice pick up in the next AP run (we do two payment runs per week).
3) Discount mechanics: FastPay is processed as a payment-level deduction on the remittance. For reporting, your remittance advice will show the invoice gross amount, the fast-pay discount applied, and the net paid.

Operational ask: can you confirm the AP contact and the remit-to email (we prefer invoices to land at ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com and include a PDF attachment with the PO number)? Also confirm whether you require invoice approval contact(s) for PO exceptions.

If SolacePay needs a quicker commitment from us we can provisionally enable FastPay (pending bank verification) for a single pilot invoice to prove the flow. Let me know if you'd like to run that pilot — it reduces time-to-first-payment.

Regards,
David Kim
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Park <olivia@solacepay.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding question — PO process & payment terms

David / Vanessa — thanks, this is helpful. Confirming the AP contact is AP Team <ap@solacepay.com> and remit bank details are included on the W-9 package (attached). We're happy to run the pilot — please provisionally enable FastPay for the first Net45 invoice and we'll confirm micro-deposits as soon as they hit.

Also a quick ask: can you send a sample PO PDF so our billing system can map fields correctly? If we get one sample PO and the exact vendor name string (you listed "SolacePay, Inc." which matches our docs) we can push the first invoice the same day.

I'll complete the DocuSign addendum this afternoon and reply once it's signed.

Thanks — Olivia
